The course teaches almost nothing new. We learned basically the same content as MAN335, with minor additions. The examples provided are out of date, there are minimal recent examples that relate to today's visual and digital culture except for some recent ad posters. Most advertisements and campaigns that were presented were not from recent years and did not provide insight into how an IMC campaign *today* could be successful. Most points made during the course felt trivial, and were presented as if we would find them amusing or groundbreaking when in reality, probably most of us thought it was common sense at this point (or at least something we had already learned). No matter how the instructor communicates well, the problem is with the content itself, the course needs major improvements in terms of focusing on more recent campaigns and why they are successful, as well as adding more nuance to the course. Instead of long lectures with slides, the course can be more focused on campaign formation and problem-solving where students can do small case studies where they are required to brainstorm campaign ideas to solve an issue of a brand. Also, most content was presented independent from cultural context, when in reality an IMC effort could fail in one country when it succeeded in another one. Cultural dimensions and social factors could be included in lectures to add nuance to the course and provide a more holistic understanding of IMC.

Ayrıca bu kaynakların çoğunun HBS'da okutulduğunu gördüğüm araştırdığımda iyi bir eğitim aldığımı hissettim. Olumsuz özellik ise, derslerin anlatılma şekliydi. Dersler çok fazla slayt içeriyordu, anlatım dersin içeriği de kaynaklı çok monotondu. Bunun iyileştirilmesi ve daha real case üzerine kurulu konu işlenmesinin fayda sağlanacağını düşünüyorum.
The class could have been more effective if a different instructor had taught it. The content of the course could be simplified a bit.

instructor: The instructor promotes effective participation really well. They make the student feel a part of the course. They are extremely understanding and fair.
